author: Prototype
review_text: I'm experiencing a verification issue on Android 16 (Infinix Hot 70). When I tap "Proceed to Send SMS", Google Messages opens correctly, I send the verification SMS, and I receive the OTP. However, the app never loads the OTP verification screen, so there's nowhere to enter the OTP. I've already uninstalled and reinstalled the app, restarted my phone, and tried again, but the issue persists. Please fix this compatibility bug.
